label: preparing
what: A confidential committee surprise supper/feast in the great hall for day 1 at 18:00, with 200 loaves and eight lanterns, bringing the mayor in under a lighting-inspection/operations-discussion pretext. Baker knowingly supported the confidential bread order with oven access and bread on credit; secretary learned it was a committee surprise and agreed to remind and bring the mayor for the inspection. The record does not establish any more specific occasion.
